_signals.x_guidance:
Orbis is an API marketplace with 24,000+ payable APIs. How to use:
1. Discover APIs: GET https://orbisapi.com/api/v2/x402/discovery/resources?page=1&limit=100 — returns slugs, names, descriptions, and per-call prices.
2. Call any API: GET or POST https://orbisapi.com/proxy/{slug}/{path} — the server will respond with 402 and payment instructions.
3. Pay: Re-send the request with the X-PAYMENT header populated per the x402 protocol (USDC on Base via Coinbase CDP facilitator).
4. Result: The server verifies the payment and returns the proxied API response.
Alternatively, use the Orbis LLM Gateway (OpenAI-compatible): POST https://orbisapi.com/proxy/llm-gateway/v1/chat/completions with x402 payment — supports GPT-4o, Claude Opus, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and more.
